Subject: Exec sponsor demo — VP/CIO attendance for Torrence Health

Hi Claire / Michael,

Thanks again for the time on the call earlier this week. Following up to line up a short sponsor-level demo and executive intro so we can walk your leadership through the proposed integration and SLA/architecture implications. Ideally we'd have a VP- or CIO-level attendee to ensure alignment on security and capacity expectations.

Two concise options (30–45 minutes):
- Wed, Oct 6 — 09:00–09:45 PT
- Thu, Oct 7 — 10:00–10:45 PT (my preference if it works for your execs)

If neither works, send over two slots that would work for the sponsor and I’ll coordinate. I’ve CC’d Markus (sales lead) and Marissa (Customer Success) so they can join for the run-of-show and next-step planning.

Attached: initial agenda (Torrence-demo-agenda-v1.pdf). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/54821

Thanks — happy to be flexible on timing.

Best,
Lauren Bishop

Thanks Lauren — I’ll be there for the sponsor demo. Couple quick asks so we show the right level of detail:
- Can we keep the first 10 minutes as an exec-level overview (value + SLOs/cost) and then do a 25-minute technical walkthrough focused on architecture, data controls, and failover?
- Please include a one-slide summary of retention & audit log controls for Michael/Dana (they asked).
- Who from our solutions engineering team will be on the call? If no one is available, I can cover the demo but would prefer a SE for live Q&A.

If you send a final run-of-show and the updated agenda I’ll prep slides for the SLO/cost piece.

—Markus

Subject: Final: Exec sponsor demo confirmed — Thu Oct 7, 10:00–10:45 PT

All — sending final confirmation and calendar invite. Meeting is scheduled for Thu Oct 7, 10:00–10:45 PT. Final run-of-show and agenda attached (Torrence-demo-agenda-v2.pdf). Invite (.ics) attached as Torrence-demo-invite.ics. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/54821

Run-of-show (brief):
- 10:00 — 10:10 — Executive intro & value overview (Lauren + Markus)
- 10:10 — 10:35 — Technical walkthrough (SE) — architecture, data controls, failover
- 10:35 — 10:43 — Decision points & procurement path (Lauren)
- 10:43 — 10:45 — Next steps / action items (Marissa)

Decision points for Torrence to consider ahead of the call:
- Expected throughput SLA and burst capacity needs
- Desired data retention/audit log policy (we’ll present options)
- Preferred rollout timeline for Dedicated vs Hosted (pilot plan)

Markus — we’ve asked solutions engineering to join (Aisha Rahman on the SE side). Marissa will own the follow-up items and procurement checklist.

Thanks again — looking forward to the discussion. I’ll update the HubSpot deal post-call with notes and next steps.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
